description: Read one stock's public on-chain activity: its price, 24-hour change, market cap and tokenized value, its holder count, each token's supply and premium by chain and tokenizer, and its recent large movements. Give a chain or a tokenizer to narrow the tokens and the movements.

chain.description: A chain id or a plain chain name, such as solana, base or arbitrum.

name: get_market_activity
title: Get market activity
